Chapter 123 0120 Xie Yang's Battle for Fame in the Company

Xie Yang quickly got a new position: administrator of the "Sanguosha" Tieba forum.

The Sanguosha Ba was newly created, with fewer than 2000 registered users and only a few dozen active daily users.

As soon as he took the post, he went to study other Tieba forums, taking out a small notebook to record data.

The number one Tieba was the Jay Chou Ba, with nearly 100,000 registered users.

The second was the Legend of Mir Ba, with over 80,000 registered users. But its activity level surpassed the Jay Chou Ba, as could be seen from the number of new posts and replies.

Additionally, besides the more popular celebrity Tieba forums, those with higher activity levels included the Chinese Paladin Ba, Naruto Ba, and so on.

Back at the dorm that night, Xie Yang looked at his little notebook and pondered a promotion plan.

Seeing him hunched over, writing and drawing, Cai Yifei asked curiously, "What are you doing?"

Xie Yang said, "I'm thinking about how to grow the Sanguosha Ba, and how to convert more people into Sanguosha players."

"Damn, still working after getting off work?" Cai Yifei said, continuing his game with a cigarette dangling from his lips.

Ding Qiang, on the other hand, was poring over a handwritten notebook, his fingers occasionally clattering on the keyboard.

Last month, Python 2.4 was released, further consolidating the stability of the Python 2.x series. Although it still wasn't a mainstream language, the Python community was constantly growing, with more and more people adopting it.

Ding Qiang knew his skills were lacking, and the company happened to have two experts, so he worked hard during the day and took the opportunity to ask them for guidance. After work, he would study the notes he took from them, earnestly improving himself bit by bit.

He couldn't help it; he was just too slow.

When asking the experts for advice, Cai Yifei could grasp things quickly, whereas Ding Qiang had to repeatedly review and practice to understand.

After finishing his plan, Xie Yang asked, "Who here knows Photoshop?"

"We both do, what's up?" Cai Yifei asked.

Xie Yang looked at the time. "Nothing. It's getting late, we'll talk tomorrow."

The next day.

Chen Guiliang looked at Xie Yang's promotional plan. "This thing is a mess. You need to familiarize yourself with proper writing formats later. But the idea is good, you can go ahead and try it."

Chen Guiliang picked up a pen and added to Xie Yang's plan, fleshing out the details.

"This might be more effective. You can temporarily assign a programmer and a clerk to help you."

A little over ten minutes later, the proposal, now covered in dense revisions, was back in Xie Yang's hands.

Xie Yang took it and looked closely, realizing his own plan was very fragmented. Chen Guiliang's revisions made it more systematic. Moreover, the operational steps were more methodical, not scattershot like what he had proposed.

That afternoon, a post appeared on the "Sanguosha Ba": "When 'Sanguosha' Rules Invade the World of 'Chinese Paladin'."

It began with a two or three-hundred-word background summary, basically about how the world of "Chinese Paladin" had been invaded by the rules of Sanguosha.

Then, hero cards of the main characters were posted.

"Li Xiaoyao—Wandering Swordsman. 4 Health. Faction: Wanderer. Sword Control: During your action phase, you may discard X hand cards to use a 'Strike' on a character. If this 'Strike' deals damage, you may draw a card. X is your increased attack range. Chivalrous Heart (Lord Skill): You may have a Wanderer-faction character use a 'Strike' for you."

"Zhao Ling'er—Descendant of Nuwa. 3 Health. Faction: Wanderer. Five Spirits Spell: During your action phase, you may use any spade hand card as 'Lightning,' or any heart hand card as a 'Peach.' Limit once per turn. Nuwa's Blessing: When you become the target of a 'Strike' or 'Duel,' if your health is lower than the attacker's, they must discard a hand card for it to take effect."

Besides them, there were also Lin Yueru, A'nu, the Wine Sword Immortal, and the Moon Worship Cult Leader.

Xie Yang, along with a clerk, started pretending to be forum members and replied to the post.

"Wow, the original poster is so talented."

"I love 'Chinese Paladin' too, I'm going to share this post on the Chinese Paladin Ba."

This type of gameplay was quite novel. Soon, over twenty active users from the Sanguosha Ba came to check it out.

Moreover, Xie Yang also switched accounts, pretending to be a basketball fan, and designed text-only hero cards for figures like Jordan, Kobe, and Yao Ming.

Inspired by this, the forum members began proposing all sorts of ideas, extending the hero card characters to their own favorite fields.

Even a hero card for Lin Daiyu was created!

Of course, they were all text-only, as not many people knew Photoshop back then.

After getting things rolling on the Sanguosha Ba, Xie Yang then shared the post on the Chinese Paladin Ba.

There were currently two forums for Chinese Paladin, one with "Legend" in the name and one without. The former had more members.

Both of these Chinese Paladin forums were created in early 2004.

At first, only game fans gathered there. But with the TV series of "Chinese Paladin" about to air, a large number of promotional stills had already been released, and the Tieba forums were also part of their promotional targets.

The TV series hadn't even aired, but the hype was already building, and a large number of Liu Yifei's fans flooded into the forums.

Even the hero cards Xie Yang had a programmer create used stills from the "Chinese Paladin" TV series.

"Wow, Hu Ge is so handsome!"

"The celestial sister is so beautiful."

"What's Sanguosha? How do you use these skills?"

"Sanguosha is a card game, it's really fun. All of us on the Sanguosha Ba love Chinese Paladin and the celestial sister. Friends from the Chinese Paladin Ba are welcome to visit."

"Looks interesting, I'll go check out the Sanguosha Ba."

Of the first twenty or so replies, most were orchestrated by Xie Yang and the clerk.

Ding Qiang was in charge of Photoshopping the hero cards. He had already PS'd several Chinese Paladin characters and was currently working on characters from Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils.

Because of the popularity of the "Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils" series last year, the Demi-Gods Ba also had a large number of users.

It was all about piggybacking on popularity.

Whichever Tieba was hot, Xie Yang would go and ride its coattails.

"How's it going?" Chen Guiliang walked over and asked.

Xie Yang said, "It's been half an hour since I shared the post, and the Sanguosha Ba has gained over 80 new members. Also, the activity on Sanguosha Ba has increased, a lot of lurkers are coming out. I'm currently trying to guide the new members to download the game."

"Good, keep it up. By the way, send me the PS images," Chen Guiliang said, quite satisfied.

As he continued to update "Those Things in the Ming Dynasty" on his blog, and with Li Xunhuan getting well-known authors to help promote it, Chen Guiliang's blog followers were increasing daily.

Chen Guiliang posted the Photoshopped hero cards and wrote on his blog, "The members of the Sanguosha Ba are so talented, this is hilarious. Everyone, come see Zhao Ling'er and Wang Yuyan, whose skills are more powerful?"

Then, Chen Guiliang switched accounts and personally went to various major BBS and forums to post.

He also guided netizens to design their own hero cards.

After some thought, Chen Guiliang also started designing hero cards. For example, Tyson's skill was biting ears. Basically, the more absurd, the better.

The era of internet trolling had just begun. The term "惡搞" (è'gǎo, meaning to prank or spoof) had appeared, but it hadn't yet become a phenomenon.

Chen Guiliang didn't mind giving it a little push.

Most netizens, let alone Sanguosha, didn't even know what tabletop games were. Seeing those ridiculous hero cards, they had no idea what was going on. Chen Guiliang naturally had his employees explain in the replies.

How many game users could be converted was secondary. The main goal was to let more netizens know about and understand tabletop games and Sanguosha.

Pioneering!

This went on for a full three days.

Xie Yang said, "The Sanguosha Ba now has over 6,000 members, and there are a lot of active daily users. But things have gone a bit off track. Less than forty percent of the posts are about the game, the rest are very… very nonsensical."

"Trolling?" Chen Guiliang said.

"Yes, exactly, trolling," Xie Yang replied.

It seemed that in this timeline, the Sanguosha Ba was destined to evolve in a more absurd direction.

Xie Yang said, "Among the new members, there are even some Photoshop experts. They don't P hero cards, they just grab all sorts of photos and randomly P them."

"Hey, that's an idea."

Chen Guiliang picked up a digital camera, called over Xie Yang and a female employee, Gong Xiaozhen, and also paid to hire the cleaning lady from the science park building.

Gong Xiaozhen stood by the roadside, looking at her phone.

Xie Yang stood in front, making a peace sign.

The cleaning lady was sweeping the floor in the background.

An hour later, a new post appeared on the Sanguosha Ba: "This is the girl I like, I secretly took a photo with her. But that cleaning lady is such an eyesore, could an expert on the forum P her out?"

A few minutes later, an "expert" replied with a photo: "Sure, wish granted. Please check it, OP."

It was pure trolling.
